ADVISORY COMMISSION ON AGING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 8, 2025
  1150 E. 4TH STREET
  LONG BEACH SENIOR CENTER, ROOM 202, 10:00 AM

Michele Valencia, Chair  Carolyn Hines, Commissioner
Sheila Gibbons, Vice Chair  Sylvia Salcedo, Commissioner
Norma Chinchilla, Commissioner  Phyllis Schmidt, Commissioner
Judi Clarke, Commissioner  Harold Sutherland, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  IRENE.RODRIGUEZ@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56655  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Advisory Commission on Aging
  meeting of Wednesday, September 10, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56656  Recommendation to receive and file an update on Citywide Senior Programming
  from Recreation Superintendent, Heidi Mazas.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56658  Recommendation to discuss and, if appropriate, approve and submit a letter to
  Mayor and City Council regarding the City’s budget as it relates to aging adults.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56659  Recommendation to discuss the 2023 Advisory Commission on Aging Visibility
  Plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56660  Recommendation to consider the creation of a Long Beach City Budget and
  Funding for Aging Adults Ad Hoc Committee and, if appropriate, appoint members.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  Due to a technical issue, the audio was muted at the beginning of the meeting.

CALL TO ORDER

At 10:07 AM, Chair Valencia called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Chinchilla, Salcedo, Hines, Schmidt, Sutherland, Gibbons, Valencia

Commissioners Absent: Clarke

Also present: Heidi Mazas, Recreation Superintendent, Irene Rodriguez, Clerk Typist, Vanessa Hall,
City Clerk Specialist.

Commissioner Clarke was excused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Hines led the Pledge of Allegiance.

 Vice Chair Gibbons provided the land acknowledgment.

REGULAR AGENDA

  meeting of Wednesday, September 10, 2025.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Hines, seconded by Commissioner
  Schmidt, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  7  Chinchilla, Salcedo, Hines, Schmidt, Sutherland, Gibbons, Valencia
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
